What should a ticket QR code link to?
Your ticket page, a check-in form, or the event details page. The code simply opens that page on the guest’s phone — keep the page itself as the source of truth for entry.
Can I make a different code for every ticket?
Yes — Batch mode generates one code per link: paste one ticket link per line, download them all as a ZIP, and print each on its own ticket.
Do ticket QR codes expire?
No. Static codes never expire. If the event moves, point the page behind the code at the new details — or, with a dynamic code, repoint the code itself without reprinting.
How big should I print it on a ticket?
At least 2 × 2 cm with a clear quiet margin, at 1024 px export or higher. At a busy entrance, bigger is safer — a code that scans first try keeps the line moving.
